539-1462-3821-4679-5147.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4679-5147.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat

512-527-1432.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-527-1432.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
512-527-1432.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-527-1432.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1456-5078-6968-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-3899-3927.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege.
Repeat.

112-622-757-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
112-622-757-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Clockspinning to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Kamahl, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

851-2557-3129-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-2557-3129-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1439-3191-3890-4050-7752.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Protean Raider, adding {B}.
When Protean Raider dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Unearth and up to one other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, returning Protean Raider from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Kairi.
Repeat.

4694-5231-7652.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-5434-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1368-2172-6898.description:
Cast Burning Inquiry by paying {R}.
Electro triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Burning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards and discard three cards at random.
Cast Burning Inquiry from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7379.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-7297.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

719-2366-5231-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-5231-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

586-1472-5256-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-5256-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

874-1170-1329-1849.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-1849.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1796-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master by paying {2}{W}
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

301-1099-6602.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

851-4231-4321-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
851-4231-4321-5777.notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

575-1894-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1894-5971.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Yedora triggers, returning Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Bile Urchin enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bile Urchin by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Bile Urchin face-up.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

851-1445-2366-4826-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
851-1445-2366-4826-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2079-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2239-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2239-4377-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

4050-4770-6073-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it, Angelic Sell-Sword and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Resolve the Angelic Sell-Sword trigger, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cat and Mercenary, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1594-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1350-2792-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{W}{U}.
1350-2792-5778.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2307-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Corsair Captain.
When Corsair Captain enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Corsair Captain triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Corsair Captain that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Corsair Captain token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

411-877.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand from the battlefield, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2} due to Morophon.
Repeat.

1349-2034-2793-3088-4742.notablePrerequisites: Xenic Poltergeist does not have summoning sickness.
1349-2034-2793-3088-4742.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability and Nahiri's Resolve trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Nahiri's Resolve trigger from step 2, exiling Ugin's Nexus until your next upkeep.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Nahiri's Resolve triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1742-1797-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: At least two creatures have died this turn.
1742-1797-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar Altar by sacrificing Inga, adding {C}{C}.
When Inga dies, it's second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Inga trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Inga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Inga enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to scry 3.
Repeat.

2167-3234-4050-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
2167-3234-4050-5140.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing all lands you control, adding one mana of any type the land can produce.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {B}.
World Shaper dies, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning World Shaper onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4221-4670.description:
Cast Living Plane by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Living Plane enters the battlefield, triggering Doomwake Giant, giving all opposing creatures -1/-1 until end of turn.
Because Living Plane causes all lands to be 1/1 creatures, all of your opponent' lands die as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.

327-914-1651-3094.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
327-914-1651-3094.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine, paying {2} to copy the Dockside Extortionist trigger.
Resolve the copy, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens, tapping two Treasure tokens to untap Lithoform Engine.
Sacrifice two Treasure tokens for {2}.
Aetherworks Marvel triggers twice, adding {E}{E}.
Repeat step 3 through 6.
Activate Aetherworks Marvel, paying six {E} to look at the top six cards of your library and you may cast a spell from amoung them.
activate Clock of Omens, tapping two Treasure tokens to untap Aetherworks Marvel.
Repeat steps 7 through 9.

2034-4840-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

391-3147-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3147-4222.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
